h: The Shabbos Mussaf Reveals Peace and the Gift of Holiness

p: שֶׁל שַׁבָּת וְיָמִים טוֹבִים שֶׁל כָּל הַשָּׁנָה
of Shabbos and the Yamim Tovim of the whole year.
And there is a difference between the Mussaf of Shabbos
and the Mussafim of the festivals:
שֶׁבְּשַׁבָּת יֵשׁ רַק שְׁנֵי כְבָשִׂים לְעוֹלָה
on Shabbos there are only two lambs as an olah,
with no bulls and no ram among them,
and no goat as a chatas,
as there are in the other Mussafim.
Now, that it has no chatas
יִתָּכֵן עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (שַׁבָּת קיח, ב)
may be explained by what they said (Shabbos 118b):
for even if he worships idols like the generation of Enosh,
for he has been atoned without an offering.
And the Ramban, of blessed memory, wrote,
"There is no chatas in the Mussafim of Shabbos
as in all the other Mussafim,
because Knesses Yisrael is its mate
And his intent is to what they said
כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא בֶּן זוּגֵךְ וְכוּלֵּי
and so is the Recanati's reading;
and this reading appears to be the main one.
For according to our reading, "your mate,"
bestow and bring holiness into Shabbos;
but in truth the holiness of Shabbos
is fixed and established from Hashem Yisbarach,
"to know that I am Hashem Who sanctifies you."
וְגִירְסַת כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל הִיא בַּת זוּגֵךְ
And the reading "Knesses Yisrael is your consort"
means that the attribute of Malchus,
which is the day of Shabbos,
that is, it draws the flow from the Name Havayah.
וְזֶה שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר לָדַעַת כִּי אֲנִי ה׳ מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם
And this is what is said, "to know that I am Hashem Who sanctifies you":
And likewise the extra soul is called a bride,
וְזֶהוּ כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל יִהְיֶה בַּת זוּגֵךְ
and this is "Knesses Yisrael will be your consort,"
And so it is stated (Shemos Rabbah 25):
with the queen sitting opposite him:
whoever passes between them is liable to death."
For on Shabbos the whole day
is the aspect of the unification
of the Holy One, blessed is He, and Yisrael,
which is the aspect of the unification
of the Holy One, blessed is He, and His Shechinah;
for with every mitzvah we say,
לְשֵׁם יִחוּד קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּשְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ
"For the sake of the unification of the Holy One, blessed is He, and His Shechinah."
since a person is accustomed to work
all six days of the week,
כְּבָא לְיָדוֹ דְּבַר עֲבֵירָה וְנִיצּוֹל הֵימֶנָּה
like one to whom a sin came and who was saved from it,
who is considered as doing a mitzvah
הוּא יִחוּד קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּשְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ
is the unification of the Holy One, blessed is He, and His Shechinah,
for one could easily come to desecrate Shabbos,
עַל יְדֵי בּוֹרֵר וּשְׁאָר מְלָאכוֹת קַלּוֹת
through sorting and other light labors.
And because of this the whole day
הוּא קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּכְנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל
is the Holy One, blessed is He, and Knesses Yisrael,
and the queen sitting opposite him;
וּמִשּׁוּם הָכִי עוֹבֵד כּוֹכָבִים שֶׁשָּׁבַת חַיָּיב
that is why a gentile who rests on Shabbos is liable.
And this is what they said:
וְעַל כָּל פָּנִים יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵם בַּת זוּגוֹ
and in any case Yisrael are His consort.
And what the Ramban wrote, "and all is peace,"
will be understood according to what is said
which is the peace of the upper and lower worlds."
And likewise in the holy Zohar (Zohar Chadash, Toldos),
which counts the seven Mussafim of the festivals
it counts the Mussaf of Shabbos
opposite "the tzaddik, foundation of the world,"
and this is what is said,
"for all that is in heaven and on earth,"
"which holds fast to heaven and earth";
that is, "the foundation of the world,
and 'on earth,' which is called, etc."
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק א לא, סוֹף עַמּוּד א)
וְהוּא יִחוּד קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּשְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ
and this is the unification of the Holy One, blessed is He, and His Shechinah.
the whole day is the unification, as stated.
וּמִדַּת יוֹסֵף בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ נִקְרָא שָׁלוֹם
And the attribute of Yosef is called peace in the holy Zohar,
for "truth and peace are bound one with the other"
and "Yaakov and Yosef are as one"
and this is why it says,
"Shabbos, which is the peace of the upper and lower worlds."
of the Holy One, blessed is He, and His Shechinah,
וְהַיִּחוּד אֵינוֹ רַק עִם עִלַּת הָעִלּוֹת
and the unification is only with the Cause of causes
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קט, ב)
and the Cause of causes rests upon them,
that is, the unification of yud-hei with vav-hei.
except when the memory of Amalek is erased;
דְּכָל זְמַן שֶׁזַּרְעוֹ שֶׁל עֲמָלֵק קַיָּים
for "as long as the seed of Amalek exists,
the Name is not complete, etc."
(as is written in Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Seitzei);
and Amalek is the evil inclination,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קס, א)
"'And the Children of Yisrael shall keep the Shabbos,
corresponding to the upper and lower Shechinah."
"And the Children of Yisrael shall keep the Shabbos"
is the upper Shabbos, the aspect of the upper hei.
who makes a dwelling for them on Shabbos
in the two chambers of the heart,
and the yetzer hara clears out from there, etc."
And this is the erasing of Amalek;
and then the unification is made,
וְגַם יִחוּד קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּכְנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל
and also the unification of the Holy One, blessed is He, and Knesses Yisrael;
and this is what the Ramban, of blessed memory, said,
and therefore no chatas at all is needed.

p: וּמַה שֶּׁאֵין בְּמוּסַף שַׁבָּת פַּר וְאַיִל
And that there is no bull and ram in the Mussaf of Shabbos
is according to what they said
one ram, corresponding to Yitzchak, etc.;
one lamb, corresponding to Yaakov, etc."
And all the festivals are called "a holy convocation,"
for one must bring holiness into the festival
and draw down the holiness of the Avos;
that is why there are in them
דְּאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב רד, א)
as is stated in the holy Zohar (II 204a):
"Shin is the secret of the three Avos,
and the bas is crowned with them";
וְאָז הַקְּדוּשָּׁה הוּא מִצַּד הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
and then the holiness is from the side of Hashem Yisbarach,
and He bestows upon Yisrael holiness
from the holiness of the Avos;
מִשּׁוּם הָכִי אֵין צָרִיךְ פָּרִים וְאֵילִים
therefore bulls and rams are not needed,
along the lines of what we say,
"Yaakov and his sons rest on it,"
to be ready to receive the holiness;
and from the side of Yisrael comes the Mussaf offering,
and through it we merit as a gift
"Rest and holiness You gave to Your people,"
And this is what they said (Shabbos 10b):
מַתָּנָה טוֹבָה יֵשׁ לִי בְּבֵית גְּנָזַי
"I have a good gift in My treasure house,
and I wish to give it to Yisrael."
And this is why we say,
for Avraham and Yitzchak attain the joy,
but the essence of the gift
is "Yaakov and his sons rest on it,"
And this is along the lines of what they said
"Yaakov, of whom keeping Shabbos is written,
יָרַשׁ אֶת הָעוֹלָם שֶׁלֹּא בְּמִדָּה וְכוּלֵּי
inherited the world without limit, etc.";
אַף שֶׁבְּוַדַּאי אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
although certainly Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
among the whole Torah that he kept,
but regarding him it is not written explicitly;
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן בְּיַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
whereas regarding Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
that he acquired the holiness of Shabbos
as a possession and permanently, for all eternity.
That is why in the Mussaf of Shabbos
corresponding to Yaakov and his sons,
which correspond to Avraham and Yitzchak.

p: And even among the lambs there is a difference:
on all the festivals there are seven lambs,
on Sukkos there are fourteen lambs,
and on Shabbos there are only two lambs.
הֵם תָּמִיד כְּנֶגֶד שִׁבְעָה יְמֵי הַשַּׁבָּת
always corresponds to the seven days of the week,
seven are the days of the week."
וְהוּא כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (בְּמִדְבַּר רַבָּה נָשֹׂא הַנִּזְכָּר)
And it is as is written (Bamidbar Rabbah, Naso, mentioned):
that lambs correspond to Yaakov Avinu
and Knesses Yisrael, who are called sheep.
That is, on all the festivals
corresponding to the aspect of Knesses Yisrael,
that they bring holiness into the festivals;
and Knesses Yisrael is called Bas Sheva,
for she includes all seven attributes.
That is why there come in every Mussaf
לֹא נִצְטַוּוּ רַק עַל שְׁנֵי כְבָשִׂים
they were commanded only two lambs,
corresponding to Yaakov and his sons.
when we merit to sit "in the shade of faith,"
and seven corresponding to his sons;
for the festival of Sukkos corresponds to Yaakov,
שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא קְרָאוֹ לוֹ לְיַעֲקֹב אֵל וְכוּלֵּי
that the Holy One, blessed is He, called Yaakov "El," etc.;
that is, he is the root of Knesses Yisrael,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א ח, א)
דָּא כְּבוֹד כַּלָּה דְּאִיקְרֵי אֵל וְכוּלֵּי
this is the glory of the bride, who is called El, etc.;
every day of the year she is called El."
וְלָכֵן בָּא שִׁבְעָה כְבָשִׂים כְּנֶגֶד יַעֲקֹב
And therefore there come seven lambs corresponding to Yaakov,
and likewise seven corresponding to his sons,
that they bring holiness into the festival,
